statements.text: Daily washing of the armpits and pubic region during adolescence may help protect from infections.
Wrapping used sanitary pads before putting them in the dustbin is proper disposal that helps protect the shared environment.
Perfume on unwashed armpits provides the same protection from infection as washing.

stem:
Diya washes her armpits and pubic region daily, keeps clean during her menstrual cycle, and wraps used sanitary pads before putting them in the dustbin. A classmate says perfume on unwashed armpits is enough.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Washing and wrapped pad disposal protect body and environment; perfume on unwashed skin is not the same protection as washing.
